mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task WHERE sample_id = #{sampleId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY time_value ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY batch_id ASC, scheme_plan_id ASC, time_value ASC
SELECT * FROM lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task WHERE inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT t.* FROM lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task t INNER JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan p ON p.id = t.plan_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'NOT_STARTED' AND t.planned_date <= #{today} AND p.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY t.plan_id ASC, t.batch_id ASC, t.time_value ASC
SELECT * FROM lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'NOT_STARTED' AND planned_date <= #{today} ORDER BY batch_id ASC, time_value ASC

SELECT t.id AS timepointTaskId, s.sample_no AS sampleNo, b.batch_no AS batchNo, p.code AS planCode, p.id AS planId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.create_time AS requestTime, p.material_name AS materialName, p.material_code AS materialCode, p.material_spec AS materialSpec, t.experiment_type AS experimentType, t.storage_condition AS storageCondition, t.sample_amount AS plannedSampleAmount, t.sample_unit AS sampleUnit, t.batch_id AS batchId, t.scheme_plan_id AS schemePlanId, m.unit_id AS materialUnitId FROM lm_stability_plan_timepoint_task t JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan p ON p.id = t.plan_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 JOIN lm_stability_inspect_plan_batch b ON b.id = t.batch_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 JOIN lm_inspection_order o ON o.id = t.inspection_order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_sample s ON s.inspection_order_id = o.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON m.id = p.material_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'WAITING_SAMPLE'
AND s.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sampleNo}, '%')
AND b.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchNo}, '%')
AND p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.planCode}, '%')
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.orderNo}, '%')
AND o.create_time >= #{query.requestTimeStart}
AND o.create_time <= #{query.requestTimeEnd}
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, s.sample_no ASC
